name: forsvn-preview
description: The collaborative review surface for FORSVN. Renders any Markdown artifact into a themed, on-brand HTML preview and captures your approve / deny / request-changes decision back into the artifact — the agent drafts, you decide.

interface.shortDescription: Preview and approve FORSVN artifacts — the agent drafts, you decide
interface.longDescription: The human-in-the-loop review surface for FORSVN. Renders any Markdown artifact into a themed, on-brand HTML preview, then captures your approve / deny / request-changes decision back into the artifact's frontmatter. Run /forsvn-preview:review to list pending artifacts and open one for a decision. Skills emit plain Markdown; install this alongside forsvn to add the review UX on top.
defaultPrompt: Show me the FORSVN artifacts waiting for my review.
Open the latest draft so I can approve it or request changes.
